summary.overall: Scheduler-deadlines keeps business facts in Sheets, technical scheduler state in SQLite, and sends through role-specific bot boundaries. Silent notifications are team-scoped and tests cover cross-team leakage and draft-state privacy. No production secrets or live chat ids were introduced in the feature slice.

findings.title: Raw adapter exception text is stored and sent in admin errors
findings.description: Scheduler admin errors include str(exc) or a previously captured exception string and persist it to error_events before sending it to the admin error bot. Today the fake adapter only emits synthetic messages, but real Telegram or Google adapters can include request URLs, response bodies, chat ids, file ids, or operational details in exception text.
findings.impact: A downstream adapter error could leak unnecessary personal or operational data into SQLite and the admin error chat. This is not a direct public disclosure, but it increases blast radius and retention of sensitive diagnostics.
findings.recommendation: Normalize scheduler admin errors to safe codes and minimal context, for example error_type, participant_id/team_id, adapter name, and a sanitized failure class. Store raw exception details only in a deliberately protected debug channel if needed, and add tests that token-like strings and URLs are not persisted or sent.

privacy_review.silent_notifications: OK: messages contain count and participant display names only; tests assert no draft state and no cross-team names.
privacy_review.recipient_scoping: OK: participant reminders use PARTICIPANT_MESSAGE/main bot; silent notifications use OPERATIONAL_NOTIFICATION/notification bot for captain/tracker recipients resolved from team rows; admin errors use TECHNICAL_ERROR/error bot.
privacy_review.sqlite_storage: OK with finding SEC-001 caveat: scheduler tables store job runs, reminder attempts, and error events, not final weekly report facts.
privacy_review.production_secrets: OK: no bot tokens, Google credentials, .env values, or live production chat ids found in the reviewed feature files.

verification.secret_scan_scope: Reviewed feature files with ripgrep for token, secret, password, credential, api_key, chat_id, telegram_id, and raw error patterns.
verification.automated: Report JSON validity checked with python json.tool
